name: employee-dashboard-backend
description: Employee Task Dashboard backend: API gateway, auth service, CRM and Helpdesk mocks, Postgres migrations

scripts.setup: node setup-env.js && npm run init -w database && npm run migrate -w database
scripts.dev: npm run db:start && concurrently -k -n crm,helpdesk,auth,api -c magenta,cyan,blue,green "npm run dev -w backend/crm-mock" "npm run dev -w backend/helpdesk-mock" "npm run dev -w backend/auth-service" "npm run dev -w backend/api-gateway"
